docs.short_description: ASRock Rack W880M WS Micro-ATX workstation motherboard for Intel Core Ultra Desktop Processors (Series 2), supporting DDR5 ECC memory, PCIe 5.0 expansion, M.2, SATA, and dual Intel 1GbE networking.
docs.abstract: The ASRock Rack W880M WS is a Micro-ATX workstation motherboard based on the Intel W880 platform and Socket 1851. It supports Intel Core Ultra Desktop Processors (Series 2), DDR5 ECC/non-ECC UDIMM and CUDIMM memory, and provides four DIMM slots. The motherboard provides one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot and one PCIe 5.0 x4 slot, along with MCIO interfaces supporting PCIe connectivity. Storage options include two PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 slots and eight SATA 6Gb/s ports. Network connectivity is provided by two Intel i210 1GbE ports. Display connectivity includes HDMI and DisplayPort outputs. The W880M WS is designed for professional workstation and compute applications and provides a compact platform with flexible PCIe, storage, memory, and network expansion capabilities.

docs.short_description: ASRock Rack W880D4ID-2Q Deep Mini-ITX Server Motherboard with Intel W880 Chipset, DDR5 ECC Support, Dual 25GbE SFP28, and IPMI Remote Management.
docs.abstract: The ASRock Rack W880D4ID-2Q is a Deep Mini-ITX server motherboard based on the Intel W880 chipset and LGA1851 socket, supporting Intel Core Ultra Series 2 processors. It provides four DDR5 ECC/non-ECC UDIMM or CUDIMM memory slots, one PCIe 5.0 x16 expansion slot, dual 25GbE SFP28 ports powered by Intel E810 controllers, dedicated IPMI 2.0 remote management with ASPEED AST2600 BMC, multiple OCuLink storage interfaces, PCIe Gen5 M.2 storage support, and HDMI/VGA display outputs. The platform is designed for edge computing, storage, virtualization, networking, and compact server applications
docs.long_description:
The ASRock Rack W880D4ID-2Q is a Deep Mini-ITX server motherboard based on the Intel W880 chipset and LGA1851 socket,

It provides four DDR5 ECC/non-ECC UDIMM or CUDIMM memory slots,

dedicated IPMI 2.0 remote management with ASPEED AST2600 BMC,

multiple OCuLink storage interfaces,

PCIe Gen5 M.2 storage support, and HDMI/VGA display outputs.

The platform is designed for edge computing, storage, virtualization, networking, and compact server applications
